mapper.insert: INSERT INTO watch_history (user_id, video_id, progress_seconds, watched_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{videoId}, #{progressSeconds}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM watch_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND video_id = #{videoId}

SELECT DISTINCT m.id as manuscript_id, m.category_id, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT t.name) as tags FROM watch_history wh JOIN videos v ON wh.video_id = v.id JOIN manuscripts m ON v.manuscript_id = m.id LEFT JOIN video_tags vt ON v.id = vt.video_id LEFT JOIN tags t ON vt.tag_id = t.id WHERE wh.user_id = #{userId} AND wh.watched_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY m.id ORDER BY MAX(wh.watched_at) DESC LIMIT #{limit}
